analyst_changes: Morgan Stanley raised its target to $350 (19 Oct).
Wells Fargo cut to $329 and Cantor Fitzgerald to $310 (12 Oct); both still Overweight.

annual.note: total return by calendar year (Chartrow; 2026 to 23 Oct)

backbone: Online stores and third-party seller services: most of revenue, low margin (North America 58% of Q2 sales).
AWS cloud: 21% of Q2 sales but $16.6bn of the $27.5bn operating profit (60%), growing 37%.
Advertising $19.8bn in Q2, +26%; subscriptions (Prime) on top.
bear: Free cash flow -$11.6bn over the last 12 months as capex hit $173bn; 2026 plan raised to ~$220bn.
Long-term debt doubled to $128.9bn in six months (Dec 2025 to Jun 2026).
Q3 sales growth guided to only 9-12%, partly because Prime Day moved into Q2 (~4 points).
bull: AWS backlog $496bn; Jassy says cloud capacity is sold out through 2027 (Reuters, 22 Oct).
AWS grew 37% in Q2, its fastest in 18 quarters; advertising +26%.
58 of 60 analysts rate it Buy or Strong Buy, none Sell; average target $331.72 (StockAnalysis).
check: Market cap $2.68tn / TTM revenue $775.7bn = 3.5x sales, matching the quoted P/S. The 19.9x trailing P/E is flattered by a $53.4bn one-off gain on its Anthropic stake in Q2; the 26.4x forward P/E is the cleaner number.

events.text: Q3 2026 results; consensus EPS $1.96, revenue $202.2bn, AWS growth 30–35% expected

history_notes: Biggest recent fall: -56% (Jul 2021 to Dec 2022), recovered by Apr 2024 (Chartrow).
Now 12.7% below its 3 Aug 2026 closing high of $284.02.
Trefis: across 15 market shocks since 2007 it fell 20% on average (market 16%) and recovered from all of them. Beta 1.46.
name: Amazon.com
oneliner: Online shop, ads and AWS cloud in one. AWS makes most of the profit and is sold out of capacity; record AI spending has pushed free cash flow negative.

targets.note: Benzinga average $335.62. Morgan Stanley raised to $350 (19 Oct).

verdict: Analysts see the most upside of your Mag7 names (+34% to the average target), but free cash flow is negative while it spends ~$220bn this year. Results on Thu 29 Oct (AWS growth, 2027 capex) are the next test.

why_down.text: Q2 beat, but 2026 capex was raised to ~$220bn (memory costs) and free cash flow turned negative; Trefis says the drop came from costs, not the business.
Fell 1.9% with big tech and chipmakers on doubts about how long AI spending will last; no Amazon-specific news.
Fell 4.6% to $250.38 as Meta's spending news revived AI-financing worries across AI stocks.
